title: LSTM Models for Time Series Analysis
description: Data retrieval, data processing, model selection, and model evaluation are all controlled via hyperparameters in a single config.py file. This architecture allows for instant comparison between Simple, Stacked, and Bidirectional Machine Learning models for time series analysis.

title: Navi AI
description: Navi is a serverless, context-aware AI companion for The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. Unlike generic chatbots, this 'Navi' is constrained by your current game state via an interactive, retro themed UI (React + Vite + Tailwind CSS).

title: Graph Data Structure (C++)
description: Optimized, undirected graph engineered with an adjacency matrix to achieve O(1) time complexity.  Demonstrates foundational computational theory through independent implementations of recursive Depth-First Search (DFS) and queue-based Breadth-First Search (BFS) algorithms. (C++)

title: Interactive Portfolio
description: This responsive personal website, built with React, Vite & Vanilla CSS. Features a custom minimalist design system, real-time automation via GitHub Actions for statistics, and seamless integration with multiple third-party APIs.

title: Time-based commit message prefixes
description: A tool to automatically add a prefix to commit messages based on the time of day.

title: Coming Soon!
description: A tool to scrape metadata for retro games.
